_comment: Soft-coded configuration for the Tag Naming & Acronym Check feature. Edit here — no code deploy required.
_enabled_comment: Set false to disable the entire check (button still appears but returns empty immediately).
_ai_comment: AI provider for the vision pass. 'gemini' uses GEMINI_API_KEY env var first, falls back to OpenAI (OPENAI_API_KEY). 'openai' uses OpenAI only.
_deterministic_comment: Set to false to skip the instant deterministic OCR-text checks and rely purely on AI vision.
_ai_vision_comment: Set to false to skip the AI vision pass and run deterministic checks only. Saves API quota.
_prefixes_comment: Canonical ISA-5.1 instrument and valve function codes. The AI and deterministic checks both consult this list. Extend freely — no code change required.
_equipment_comment: Valid single-letter equipment type codes. Tags matching LETTER-NUMBER are checked against this list.
_format_rules_comment: Rules for the deterministic separator and format checks.
_severity_comment: Severity level assigned to each deterministic rule. Accepted values: critical | major | minor | info.
_prompt_comment: AI vision prompt. {ocr_tags} is replaced at runtime with the OCR-extracted tag list. Edit wording here without touching any Python code.
ai_system_prompt: You are an expert P&ID reviewer for the Mubarraz Redevelopment Project (Abu Dhabi Oil Co. Ltd / Rejlers EPC, Document PJ6-EXD-GEN-BQDA-0002). You specialise in ISA-5.1 instrument tag naming conventions and the project-specific naming conventions defined in the legends sheet. Your task is to find NAMING ERRORS only — do not report connectivity, missing signal lines, or fail-safe issues.
ai_prompt_template:
Carefully study this P&ID drawing image and identify ALL tag NAMING and ACRONYM violations.

PROJECT CONTEXT: Mubarraz Redevelopment Project, Abu Dhabi Oil Co. Ltd / Rejlers EPC. Tag naming follows ISA-5.1 conventions with project-specific codes including: ZT (position transmitter), ZSH/ZSL (position switches), ST (speed transmitter), SSV (surface/subsurface safety valve), MSV (master shutdown valve), DBB (double block & bleed), RD (rupture disc), RO (restriction orifice), SDV (shutdown valve), BDV (blowdown valve), NOC (net oil computer), GWR (guided wave radar), WC (water cut), GVF (gas volume fraction). Equipment codes: P=pump, V=vessel, E=exchanger, H=heater, T=tank, K=compressor, C=column, MX=mixer, MG=generator, TR=transformer, W=well.

OCR-extracted tags for cross-reference (may be incomplete or contain OCR artefacts):
{ocr_tags}

Check ONLY for these naming error types:
1. WRONG SEPARATOR — tag uses space, underscore, slash or dot instead of dash  (e.g. 'PI 3610', 'PI_3610', 'PI/3610' — correct form is 'PI-3610' or '16-PI-3610')
2. MISSING SEPARATOR — function code and number fused without any separator  (e.g. 'PI3610' — correct form is 'PI-3610')
3. UNKNOWN ACRONYM — function letter code is not a recognised ISA-5.1 code and not listed in the project legend (e.g. 'IP' instead of 'PI', 'TF' instead of 'FT', 'FP' instead of 'PF')
4. INCOMPLETE TAG — only the function code is visible with no number  (e.g. just 'PI' inside a bubble with no sequential number)
5. INCONSISTENT FORMAT — some tags on this drawing use an area prefix (e.g. '16-PI-3610') and others do not ('PI-3610') with no apparent rule
6. EQUIPMENT TAG ERROR — equipment follows wrong format (should be TYPE-NUMBER, e.g. P-3610, V-101, MX-3600, TR-3610)

IMPORTANT RULES:
- Only report issues you can VISUALLY CONFIRM by reading the text on the drawing.
- Do NOT hallucinate tags or issues that are not clearly visible.
- Each issue must cite the exact text string as drawn.
- If a tag looks partially cut off by a cloud or border, note that in location_hint.
- Provide ONE entry per unique tag instance found to be problematic.

Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown fences):
{
  "naming_issues": [
    {
      "tag_found":     "PI 3610",
      "issue_type":    "wrong_separator",
      "description":   "Tag bubble shows 'PI 3610' — space used instead of dash separator",
      "suggested_fix": "PI-3610",
      "severity":      "major",
      "location_hint": "Middle-Left zone, on 4\"-HC-3610 line"
    }
  ],
  "summary": "Found 1 naming violation: 1 wrong separator"
}
